The issuer shows weak near-term liquidity (current ratio 0.79) and high balance-sheet leverage, with liabilities of roughly 73% of assets and only modest operating earnings relative to its large liability base. While the company has substantial equity and accumulated retained earnings, the low EBIT-to-assets profile suggests only moderate capacity to absorb stress, consistent with a speculative-grade but not deeply distressed credit.
